The '''Evidence facility''' was a building owned by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Ministry of Intelligence/Legends|Republic Ministry of Intelligence]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it housed an authentic recording of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Deputy Minister/Legends|Deputy Minister]] [[Jerec/Legends|Jerec's]] testimony regarding the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] insurgency and the [[Mandalore Defense Resolution/Legends|Mandalore Defense Resolution]]. Ministry employee [[Davu Golec/Legends|Davu Golec]] pilfered this recording from the facility in order to provide it to his friend, the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].
